purdue-bladder-pdl1-vinblastine-deracoxi.identity: Exact active Knapp combination, same three agents in three sequences; preceding monotherapy and CDK9 sections explicitly completed.
purdue-bladder-pdl1-vinblastine-deracoxi.recruitment_sites: Active at Purdue University Veterinary Hospital, West Lafayette IN; all IV treatments and monitoring there.
purdue-bladder-pdl1-vinblastine-deracoxi.eligibility: Good general health, creatinine ≤2 mg/dL, biopsy confirmed or strongly suspected bladder/urethral InvUC to confirm by study; no prior RT/chemo; NSAID washout 5–14 days; supplements 2 weeks; no Librela/Cytopoint.
purdue-bladder-pdl1-vinblastine-deracoxi.funding: Owner pays $300 per Purdue visit; other Purdue treatment, monitoring and side-effect care covered. Referring vet, unrelated care and off-study costs not covered.
purdue-bladder-pdl1-vinblastine-deracoxi.deadline: No published intake cutoff; visit schedule is not a deadline.

purdue-hifu-lymphoma.identity: Named HIFU ablation of one enlarged node followed by standard UW-25 CHOP, Dervisis/Childress.
purdue-hifu-lymphoma.recruitment_sites: Individual protocol marked Currently Enrolling at Purdue in West Lafayette; vet written referral required.
purdue-hifu-lymphoma.eligibility: Dog ≥1 year, >8 kg, newly confirmed untreated intermediate/large-cell multicentric B/T-cell lymphoma; exclude stage V/extranodal and small-cell; 3-week anticancer treatment and 2-week steroid windows, staging and anesthesia fit.
purdue-hifu-lymphoma.funding: HIFU/protocol biopsies/labs covered; $2,000 CHOP credit plus up to $2,000 for HIFU adverse effects or CHOP; initial workup, unrelated care, outside emergencies owner-paid.
purdue-hifu-lymphoma.deadline: No dated cutoff; 25 weeks refers to CHOP.

purdue-hfire-liver-cancer.identity: Exact Dervisis preoperative nonthermal high-frequency irreversible electroporation followed by liver tumor resection.
purdue-hfire-liver-cancer.recruitment_sites: Individual protocol Currently Enrolling at Purdue University Veterinary Hospital, West Lafayette.
purdue-hfire-liver-cancer.eligibility: Dog with one or more surgically resectable liver tumors; suitable for biopsy, anesthesia and surgery, accepts subsequent resection; exclude prohibitive coagulopathy, illness or anesthetic risk.
purdue-hfire-liver-cancer.funding: H-FIRE, post-H-FIRE CT and rechecks covered with $2,000 surgical credit; other surgical costs and unrelated complications owner-paid. Typical gross surgery $4,000–$8,000, not net obligation.
purdue-hfire-liver-cancer.deadline: No recruitment deadline; 5–7 days interval to surgery.

purdue-hifu-osteosarcoma.identity: Exact Dervisis/Childress partial HIFU before limb amputation and adjuvant carboplatin.
purdue-hifu-osteosarcoma.recruitment_sites: Individual protocol Currently Enrolling at Purdue, West Lafayette.
purdue-hifu-osteosarcoma.eligibility: Dog ≥1 year, >8 kg, confirmed limb OSA, no metastasis, acoustically accessible tumor and anesthesia/surgery fit; no chemo in last 3 weeks or steroids in last 2 weeks.
purdue-hifu-osteosarcoma.funding: HIFU and functional imaging covered; up to $2,600 amputation credit, chemo rechecks covered; screening, balance of surgery, carboplatin administration and surgical complications owner-paid.
purdue-hifu-osteosarcoma.deadline: No published intake deadline; post-treatment surveillance schedule is separate.

aurelius-lytix-bcell-lymphoma.identity: Exact Aurelius/Lytix pilot oncolytic peptide with immune therapy for B-cell lymphoma, distinct from routine non-genetically modified ACT service.
aurelius-lytix-bcell-lymphoma.recruitment_sites: Official sponsor home dialog explicitly recruiting; almost all visits in Bellingham WA; no second site stated.
aurelius-lytix-bcell-lymphoma.eligibility: Previously untreated canine B-cell lymphoma stage 3–5(a); informed consent and ability to attend 3-day initial and ≥2 follow-up visits; remaining exact screening not publicly stated.
aurelius-lytix-bcell-lymphoma.funding: Sponsor states no additional trial expense to owners. Do not transfer fees from separate ACT service.

illinois-oral-melanoma-il12-il15.identity: Single RT dose then four intratumoral CD45-binding IL-12/IL-15 injections in 1–5 cm oral melanoma
illinois-oral-melanoma-il12-il15.recruitment_sites: Active exact linked study in Illinois current clinical trials, Urbana, with treatment at the veterinary teaching hospital.
illinois-oral-melanoma-il12-il15.eligibility: Dog ≥1 year and 8 kg, cytology/histology confirmed oral melanoma, adequate function for sedation and contrast; no prior radiation, chemotherapy or immunotherapy; no immune-modulating/alternative treatment during study
illinois-oral-melanoma-il12-il15.funding: Fully funded after eligibility; owner pays initial exam/diagnostics and unrelated care. Approx $200 consultation excludes testing.
illinois-oral-melanoma-il12-il15.deadline: No dated recruitment cutoff; any course/follow-up duration is relative to participation.

illinois-sts-surgery.identity: One JEN-101 intratumoral injection seven days after biopsy, resection seven days later; surgery at Illinois mandatory
illinois-sts-surgery.recruitment_sites: Active exact linked study in Illinois current clinical trials, Urbana, with treatment at the veterinary teaching hospital.
illinois-sts-surgery.eligibility: Dog with confirmed resectable STS 1–5 cm; no prior radiation; three-week chemo washout; no immunosuppressive or alternative treatment on study
illinois-sts-surgery.funding: Drug, biopsy and treatment-day exam covered; up to $2,500 toward Illinois surgery. Initial exam/diagnostics and unrelated care owner-paid.
illinois-sts-surgery.deadline: No dated recruitment cutoff; any course/follow-up duration is relative to participation.

illinois-sts-treatment.identity: Four intratumoral JEN-101 injections q2 weeks for recurrent STS, distinct from single injection with resection
illinois-sts-treatment.recruitment_sites: Active exact linked study in Illinois current clinical trials, Urbana, with treatment at the veterinary teaching hospital.
illinois-sts-treatment.eligibility: Previously resected and confirmed recurrent canine STS >2 cm; no radiation/chemo in last six weeks; no prior immunotherapy, steroids, Apoquel or other immunomodulators; fit for sedation and contrast
illinois-sts-treatment.funding: Fully funded after eligibility; initial workup and unrelated care owner-paid, initial consultation about $200 plus testing.
illinois-sts-treatment.deadline: No dated recruitment cutoff; any course/follow-up duration is relative to participation.

illinois-ucc-gilvetmab-epacadostat.identity: Gilvetmab alone or plus oral epacadostat with piroxicam/gabapentin in both arms
illinois-ucc-gilvetmab-epacadostat.recruitment_sites: Active exact linked study in Illinois current clinical trials, Urbana, with treatment at the veterinary teaching hospital.
illinois-ucc-gilvetmab-epacadostat.eligibility: Dog with visible bladder mass on ultrasound and cytology or BRAF-positive molecular test; fit for repeated sedation; no prior chemo, RT or immunotherapy
illinois-ucc-gilvetmab-epacadostat.funding: Fully funded once eligible; up to $500 for protocol adverse events treated at Illinois; owner pays initial eligibility and unrelated care.
illinois-ucc-gilvetmab-epacadostat.deadline: No dated recruitment cutoff; any course/follow-up duration is relative to participation.

vt-liver-laseit-pdt.identity: Exact Jo Tuohy LASEIT-PDT, CT-guided verteporfin injection followed by scheduled liver tumor resection.
vt-liver-laseit-pdt.recruitment_sites: Virginia Tech official current studies and individual protocol, Blacksburg.
vt-liver-laseit-pdt.eligibility: Dog with newly diagnosed surgically resectable liver tumor; owner elects resection; CT/blood work fit and no other life-threatening disease.
vt-liver-laseit-pdt.funding: PDT, recheck CT and two ICU nights covered; $2,000 toward standard surgery; diagnosis, travel, remaining surgery and PDT complications owner-paid.
vt-liver-laseit-pdt.contacts: Robyn Fox LVT, Virginia Tech clinical trials coordinator.
vt-liver-laseit-pdt.deadline: No published cutoff; two days is time between study PDT and surgery.

vt-brain-verteporfin-pdt.identity: Exact intraoperative verteporfin and surgical-margin light activation for new resectable canine brain tumor.
vt-brain-verteporfin-pdt.recruitment_sites: Current Virginia Tech protocol specifies study and six follow-up visits in Blacksburg.
vt-brain-verteporfin-pdt.eligibility: New MRI or biopsy-confirmed resectable brain tumor in dog stable for anesthesia; no previous brain tumor chemotherapy, RT or other therapy; severe concurrent illness excludes.
vt-brain-verteporfin-pdt.funding: Scheduled exams, tests, resection, anesthesia, study MRI and PDT covered. Initial diagnosis, travel, preexisting seizure treatment and outside/emergency care owner-paid.
vt-brain-verteporfin-pdt.contacts: Mindy Quigley mindyq@vt.edu; hospital urgent routing 540-231-4621.
vt-brain-verteporfin-pdt.deadline: No published recruitment end. Approx six months is participant follow-up.

vt-canine-glioma-ced.identity: Molecularly targeted cytotoxins infused directly into canine glioma under MRI monitoring. Wake Forest developed compounds, not published separate enrolling site.
vt-canine-glioma-ced.recruitment_sites: Virginia Tech Neurology clinical trial current exact pages; treatment through the Virginia Tech neurology team.
vt-canine-glioma-ced.eligibility: Dog 3–45 kg, mild/moderate symptoms, one MRI mass ≥1 cm, not involving ventricles or brainstem; no prior RT, chemo/surgery last 6 weeks, immunotherapy last 6 months; exclude uncontrolled seizures or relevant concurrent illness.
vt-canine-glioma-ced.funding: Initial diagnostic MRI, travel, seizures, local and emergency care owner-paid; eligible treatment, hospitalization and scheduled follow-up funded.
vt-canine-glioma-ced.contacts: Mindy Quigley mindyq@vt.edu; hospital urgent route 540-231-4621.
vt-canine-glioma-ced.deadline: No enrollment end; MRIs every 2–3 months up to one year are follow-up.
